test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: According to the Global Hunger Index 2022, what is the rank of the neighbouring country, Bangladesh out of 121 countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**84th**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh** is ranked **84th** out of 121 countries in the Global Hunger Index 2022.
 
• The Global Hunger Index (GHI) is a tool designed to comprehensively measure and track hunger at global, regional, and national levels.
 
• The GHI scores countries on a 100-point scale, where 0 is the best possible score (no hunger) and 100 is the worst.
 
• The index is calculated based on four key indicators: undernourishment, child stunting, child wasting, and child mortality.
 
• Countries with higher GHI scores are experiencing higher levels of hunger and undernutrition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Global Hunger Index** is published annually by Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe.
 
• The 2022 report highlights that progress in combating hunger has been uneven across regions and countries.
 
• Many countries with the highest levels of hunger have been affected by conflict, climate change, and economic shocks.
 
• Efforts to combat hunger must be multifaceted, involving improvements in food security, nutrition, health, and education.
 
• The Global Hunger Index aims to raise awareness and understanding of regional and country differences in hunger and to trigger actions to reduce hunger around the world.
